The context doesn't say. It contains no timing or benchmark data: nothing about a 655 MB monorepo, and no millisecond figure for `--max-columns 400`.

What the context does show is the mechanism. `--max-columns N` is JSON-only (src/main.zig:355-358). When it is off, output is byte-for-byte the pre-M9 output (src/main.zig:358). When it is on, the window is computed once per event, and only if `max_columns > 0` (src/out_json.zig:153-154). Rows whose line fits within the limit are emitted unchanged (src/out_json.zig:513-524).

So the cost is per emitted row, not per byte scanned. Measuring it would need a benchmark, or the README.md/GUIA.md performance sections. The search output shows no README.md or GUIA.md hits for `max_columns`, though GUIA §4s is referenced at src/main.zig:357.
